info.name: CareX — Agentic SDLC Governance Lab
info.description: Postman-first demonstration of validating AI-agent test-plan proposals. Read-only CareX health request; no collection writes, database writes or release actions.

item.name: 01 — Accept a safe, evidence-backed agent proposal

request.description: Read-only health check. The pre-request script creates a synthetic agent proposal; the test script applies deterministic policy checks.

exec: const proposal = { change_id: 'CAREX-214', source_revision: 'story-v2', proposed_actions: [{ action: 'read_contract', evidence_ref: 'openapi:sha256:demo' }, { action: 'propose_test', evidence_ref: 'requirement:BR-03' }], release_decision: 'recommend_review' };

pm.test('Proposal has change and revision traceability', function () { pm.expect(proposal.change_id).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(proposal.source_revision).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.test('Every proposed action is allow-listed and evidence-backed', function () {

proposal.proposed_actions.forEach((a, i) => { if (!allowed.includes(a.action)) errors.push('action[' + i + '] not allow-listed'); if (!a.evidence_ref) errors.push('action[' + i + '] missing evidence_ref'); });
pm.test('Agent recommends review but does not approve release', function () { pm.expect(['not_assessed', 'recommend_hold', 'recommend_review']).to.include(proposal.release_decision); });

item.name: 02 — Reject an unsafe agent proposal without performing writes

request.description: Read-only health check. The proposal contains a collection mutation and an agent release approval; tests assert that deterministic policy rejects both.

exec: const proposal = { change_id: 'CAREX-214', source_revision: 'story-v2', proposed_actions: [{ action: 'update_collection' }, { action: 'write_database' }, { action: 'send_customer_email' }], release_decision: 'approve_release' };

pm.test('Mutating and unknown actions are rejected by policy', function () { pm.expect(blocked.map(a => a.action)).to.include.members(['update_collection', 'write_database', 'send_customer_email']); });
pm.test('Agent cannot approve or execute a release', function () { pm.expect(['not_assessed', 'recommend_hold', 'recommend_review']).not.to.include(proposal.release_decision); });
pm.test('Unsafe proposal is classified as blocked for human review', function () { pm.expect(blocked.length).to.be.greaterThan(0); });
